newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - VISX estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - VISX estimates cut.

text.p: Dillon, Read & Co Inc said on Thursday it lowered its estimates on VISX Inc, after the company announced its second quarter results would likely fall below consensus estimates due to lower laser system sales.

-- Analyst Raul Esquivel said in a research note he was lowering his 1997 earnings estimate to $0.75 per share from $1.00 per share and cutting his 1998 estimate to $1.45 per share from $1.75 per share.
-- "Laser system sales appear to be tracking below expectations primarily because procedure growth in 1996 did not keep pace with the strong system sales growth," he said.
-- VISX shares closed off six points at 22-1/4.
